name: lava-lamp
title: LavaLamp
description: Wax-like blobs that rise, sink and merge behind content.

accessibility: The effect layer is aria-hidden and ignores pointer events; only children are exposed.
Pauses offscreen; `paused` stops it on demand.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) holds the blobs still at different heights.
